Riverwood is the north-east Port Coquitlam house area by the Pitt River, around Riverwood Gate and Coast Meridian Road, with Terry Fox Secondary at 1260 Riverwood Gate as its named anchor.
Terry Fox Secondary is named for Port Coquitlam's own Terry Fox, so the area's landmark school carries the city's best-known name.
Citadel lies to the west, and the Pitt River and its trail system form the area's east side.

The stock is detached houses on the Riverwood Gate and Coast Meridian Road streets, under the City's RS zones in Zoning Bylaw No. 3630: minimum lot width is 15 metres in RS1, 12 metres in RS2, 30 metres in RS3 and 9.5 metres in RS4.
Blakeburn Elementary, at 1040 Riverside Drive, and Fortress Park, at 2698 Fortress Court, are the addressed anchors inside the area's street system.

blocks.text: Riverwood Houses: local details a buyer would not know

items.t: The area's secondary school is the city's namesake school: Terry Fox Secondary at 1260 Riverwood Gate is named for Port Coquitlam's Terry Fox.
Blakeburn Elementary's address is on Riverside Drive, at 1040 Riverside Drive, not on Riverwood Gate, so the elementary anchor sits on the river-side street system.
Minnekhada Middle is the middle school in the recorded locator chain for the Riverwood Gate address, so the area's chain runs Blakeburn, Minnekhada and Terry Fox.
Coast Meridian Road is the area's north–south route, and its overpass connects north Port Coquitlam to Lougheed Highway and the Mary Hill Bypass.
The Traboulay PoCo Trail gives the river-side streets a walking and cycling route along the Pitt River.
